payload.posture: Read Philippians 1:19–26 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states life, death, fruitful labor, and remaining. For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
